objectives_fil: Sa kathang-isip na sitwasyon, maitugma ang household profile, master list, registry, at iniatas na form sa tanong na sinasagot ng bawat isa; masabi kung paano tiyakin ang detalye at ang tamang tatanggap bago magpasa.
objectives_en: Given a fictional situation, match a household profile, master list, registry, and assigned form to the question each answers; explain how to verify details and the recipient before handing information over.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang tala ay may tanong na sinasagot at taong gagamit nito.
sections.takeaway_en: A record answers a question for someone who will use it.

sections.takeaway_fil: Household profile: larawan ng isang kabahayan, hindi patunay ng serbisyong naibigay.
sections.takeaway_en: A household profile describes one household; it does not prove a service was given.

sections.takeaway_fil: Master list: sino ang kabilang sa isang grupo.
sections.takeaway_en: A master list shows who belongs to a group.

sections.takeaway_fil: Registry: sino ang nabigyan ng serbisyo, batay sa natiyak na tala.
sections.takeaway_en: A registry shows who received a service, based on verified entries.

sections.takeaway_fil: Bago ipasa: tiyakin ang hinihinging detalye, tatanggap, at aprubadong paraan.
sections.takeaway_en: Before handoff, confirm the requested details, recipient, and approved route.

sections.takeaway_fil: Piliin ang tala ayon sa tanong; tiyakin ang detalye bago magpasa.
sections.takeaway_en: Choose the record by the question; verify details before handoff.

check.prompt_fil: Hiniling ng midwife kay Marites ang tala kung sino ang nabigyan na ng health teaching. May master list siya ng mga nakatatanda at registry ng mga serbisyong naibigay, ngunit may isang entry sa registry na hindi malinaw. Ano ang pinakamainam niyang gawin?
check.prompt_en: The midwife asks Marites for the record of who has received health teaching. She has a master list of older residents and a registry of services given, but one registry entry is unclear. What should she do?

options.fil: Gamitin ang master list bilang patunay na nabigyan na ng health teaching ang lahat ng nakatatanda.
options.en: Use the master list as proof that all older residents received health teaching.

options.fil: Gamitin ang registry, linawin muna ang hindi tiyak na entry, at ihatid ang natiyak na impormasyon sa midwife sa aprubadong paraan.
options.en: Use the registry, clarify the uncertain entry, and give the verified information to the midwife through the approved route.

options.fil: Kopyahin ang mga pangalan sa iniatas na form at hulaan ang kulang na detalye para maipasa agad.
options.en: Copy the names into the assigned form and guess the missing detail so it can be submitted immediately.

check.feedback_fil: Ang registry ang tala ng mga nabigyan ng serbisyo ayon sa manual. Hindi patunay ng serbisyo ang master list. Linawin ang hindi tiyak na entry at sundin ang aprubadong lokal na paraan ng pagpapasa sa midwife.
check.feedback_en: The manual describes the registry as the record of people who received a service. The master list does not prove service delivery. Clarify the uncertain entry and follow the approved local route to the midwife.
